name: Quote
summary: Words someone said or wrote, set apart from the text around them, with who they're from and where: a testimonial, a recommendation, a line from an interview or a book. Put several in Cards for recommendations, or one per slide in a Carousel for voices. Not for repeating a line of the same article for emphasis (a pull quote is Heading or Text at a larger size) or for code (use CodeBlock).
a11y: A `figure` holding a `blockquote` and a `figcaption`, so the author and source are read as the quote's own. The quotation marks are drawn from the reader's language (`quotes`), not typed into the words, so they're never read twice. The author's avatar is hidden because their name is written beside it. With `source.href`, the source is a link and the blockquote's `cite` points to it. A loading quote is `aria-busy`.

props.name: children
props.description: The quoted words, without quotation marks: the quote adds the reader's language's own. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

props.name: author
props.description: The person it's from, shown with their avatar.

props.name: source
props.description: The work or occasion it's from.

props.name: size
props.description: `s` inside a card or beside other content, `m` (default) inside an article, `l` for the one quote a section leads with.

props.name: align
props.description: `start` (default), or `center` for a quote standing on its own, such as one slide of a carousel.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the quote's shape in shimmer while it loads.

props.name: role
props.description: One line under the name: their role and where ("Design lead, Northwind").

props.name: src
props.description: Their picture; initials show without one.

props.name: title
props.description: Where it was said or written, as its title: "The Shape of Design", "Interview, May 2026".

props.name: href
props.description: A page to read it in full: the source becomes a link, and the quote's `cite` points there.
